nights.title: The Black Dahlia Murder
nights.name: The Black Dahlia Murder
nights.extract: The Black Dahlia Murder is an American melodic death metal band from Waterford, Michigan, formed in 2001. Their name is derived from the 1947 unsolved murder of Elizabeth Short, often referred to as Black Dahlia. As of February 2025, the band consists of lead vocalist Brian Eschbach, bassist Max Lavelle, drummer Alan Cassidy and rhythm guitarist Ryan Knight. The Black Dahlia Murder has undergone various lineup changes, with Eschbach and Trevor Strnad remaining the only constant members, until the latter's death in 2022, which then saw Eschbach take over lead vocals and Knight replacing him on rhythm guitar.
